other_conditions: Agency and its functionaries must be bonafide Indian agencies and Indian citizens

Must be a registered Jute entrepreneur/manufacturer, exporter, merchant trader, NGO, cooperative society, federation, PSU/organization of Central/State Government or other firm engaged in JDP product identification and marketing for at least three years
Recognized agencies should have at least three years of experience in trading and promotion of Jute Diversified Products or similar schemes in the handloom, handicrafts, and textiles sector
Must have its own office with telephone/mobile connection, computer/laptop with email facilities
Must have at least 200 sq. ft. space for operating the JRMB
Must provide go‑down infrastructure, electricity, water and furniture at its own cost
Must maintain compulsory backward linkage with JRCPC beneficiaries for sustained supply of jute material
benefits_summary: Provides up to 30% financial support on sales value (maximum Rs 12 lakh per annum), including a 5% cash discount and transport cost reimbursement for eligible Jute Raw Material Banks.
documents_required: Hard copy proposal in sealed cover with signatures of authorized persons
